The Founders Office Associate works closely with the founders across all areas of organisation building. This is a central role that touches strategy, operations, research, partnerships, product development, communication, and internal process creation. You will act as an extension of the founders team to drive progress on high priority work and help the company scale with clarity and speed.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Support

  • Work with founders on company strategy, planning, and key decisions

  • Support creation of business models, investor material, market analysis, and reports

  • Conduct research across new sectors, partners, regulations, and emerging opportunities

Operations and Execution

  • Drive cross functional projects to completion

  • Build internal processes for planning, tracking, and reporting

  • Manage special projects across product, supply chain, marketing, and growth

  • Improve coordination between teams and ensure timely execution of tasks

Organisational Development

  • Support hiring, onboarding, and culture building initiatives

  • Work with founders to design reviews, goal setting, and company wide communication

  • Prepare material for board meetings, investor updates, and internal reviews

External Relations

  • Assist founders in managing key partners, clients, advisors, and government bodies

  • Prepare briefs, presentations, proposals, and meeting notes

  • Represent the organisation in meetings when required

Product and Innovation Support

  • Assist with product research, testing, documentation, and roll out

  • Coordinate with design, engineering, and production teams to gather insights and unblock tasks


Requirements

What We Are Looking For

  • 3-10 years of experience in consulting, venture capital, early stage startups, or fast paced roles

  • Strong problem solving skills, detail orientation, and an ability to learn fast

  • Excellent written and verbal communication

  • Comfort with ambiguity and a strong sense of ownership

  • Ability to work directly with founders and handle sensitive information

  • Curiosity across business, design, sustainability, and operations


Benefits

  • Be part of amission-firstteam solving real environmental challenges
  • Shape the narrative ofIndia’s next-generation materials brand
  • ​Experience startup life up close—at theintersection of design, science, and scale
  • Opportunity to grow into leadership roles across design, marketing, or product strategy

Du bist ein Allrounder mit Unternehmergeist und willst VOLLZEIT in einer der schnellst wachsenden Agenturen im deutschsprachigen Raum mitgestalten?

Bei RealStudio haben wir aktuell ein Team aus 22 Leuten und wachsen stark. Konkret suchen wir nach VOLLZEIT Verstärkung als Founders Associate – direkt an der Seite der Geschäftsführung.

Warum du unbedingt Teil von RealStudio werden solltest?

  • Du arbeitest direkt mit dem Founder und bekommst Einblick in alle Bereiche – von Sales über Operations bis Strategy

Wir bauen die größte Boutique Social Content Agentur für Marktführer & Scale-Ups in DACH auf.

Du bist die rechte Hand des Founders. Du springst da rein, wo es brennt – ob Prozesse aufbauen, Kundenbeziehungen stärken, neue Projekte vorantreiben oder das Team koordinieren. Kein Tag sieht gleich aus, und genau das macht die Rolle so spannend.

Wenn du also hungrig auf mehr bist, Verantwortung suchst und massiv wachsen möchtest, dann bewirb Dich jetzt.

  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit dem Founder an strategischen und operativen Projekten

  • Eigenverantwortliche Übernahme von Schlüsselprojekten über alle Bereiche hinweg

  • Aufbau, Optimierung und Dokumentation interner Prozesse, die unser Wachstum skalierbar machen

  • Koordination zwischen Teams und Sicherstellung, dass Projekte auf Kurs bleiben

  • Recherche & Vorbereitung strategischer Entscheidungen für neue Geschäftsfelder und Partnerschaften

Qualifikation

Was du dafür mitbringen musst:

  • Erfahrung im Vertrieb / Sales / Marketing (vorteilhaft)

  • Kommunikative Persönlichkeit

  • Guten Umgang mit Menschen

  • Volle Verfügbarkeit

  • den Willen, die Extrameile zu gehen

  • Top 1% Training im B2B Bereich

  • Gehalt: 4.000€ - 10.000€ pro Monat

  • Betriebliche Weiterbildung

  • Erfolgsbeteiligung

  • Homeoffice-Möglichkeit

JustPlay is looking for an experienced and business-oriented Founders Associate - Engagement Innovation to help us make JustPlay app ecosystem dramatically more fun, exciting and engaging.

You'll work directly with our founders across every product team, constantly looking for ideas that make users want to click, play, win, explore and come back.

We're not looking for someone to manage roadmaps or introduce more product processes. We're looking for someone with exceptional consumer instincts, extremely high agency and an obsession with the mechanics behind the world's most engaging B2C products.

You should be the kind of person who opens an app like TikTok, Temu, MONOPOLY GO!, Duolingo or Whatnot and immediately starts dissecting why it works and how those ideas could be applied somewhere completely different.

Some of your ideas may become major features. Others might be a different CTA, a more exciting reward reveal, a new event, better framing of a prize, or an experiment we can ship next week.

We care much more about the impact of an idea than its complexity.

Job Responsibilities

  • Work directly with the founders as a thinking partner on what makes JustPlay exciting to play

  • Embed across product teams to find opportunities — not to run them

  • Maintain a constant flow of ideas, from single-line copy changes to entirely new mechanics

  • Tear down the world's most engaging consumer apps and translate what works there into what could work here

  • Turn ideas into things people can act on: a sharp one-pager, a mock, a test plan — whatever gets it moving fastest

  • Push ideas through to launch by making yourself useful to the teams shipping them

  • Measure what happens, tell the truth about it, and scale or kill accordingly

  • Build our collective instinct for engagement, so the whole company gets better at this over time

Job Requirements

  • Exceptional consumer instincts: you can tell why something is fun or addictive, not just that it is

  • Extremely high agency: you find the problem, propose the answer, and chase it until it's live, without being assigned it

  • A genuine obsession with engagement mechanics in top B2C products such as games, social, commerce, or education

  • Evidence that your ideas have shipped and moved a number, however small the idea was

  • Fluency with data: you can read an experiment result honestly, including when it kills your favourite idea

  • You write and speak clearly enough to sell an idea to a founder and an engineer in the same afternoon

  • Comfortable being the newest voice in a room of people who know the product better than you and disagreeing anyway

  • You communicate fluently in English, both written and spoken

Nice to Have

  • Casual, hyper-casual, or rewarded mobile gaming experience

  • Background in LiveOps: events, seasons, progression, economies, or meta design

  • Hands-on experimentation experience: you've designed and read A/B tests

  • Enough technical or design literacy to mock something up yourself rather than describe it

  • Familiarity with loyalty and rewards mechanics, or the mobile advertising landscape

Job benefits

  • Work-Life Balance and Flexibility: Flexible working hours and options for digital nomads, occasional office visitors, or regular office-goers

  • Mental Health Support: Free personal coaching through our partner OpenUp to support our team members to live fulfilled lives at home and at work

  • Training & Development: A competitive personal development budget of up to 2000€/year for training, conferences, workshops, etc. and free language tutoring in German and English with Preply

  • Germany-Based Benefits: 25 vacation days, freeWellhub gold subscription, free monthly Deutschland-Ticket, and a monthly €50 tax-free internet contribution

  • State-of-the-Art Equipment: Doesn’t matter if you are a MacBook or Windows user; we will provide you with the technical gear you need to succeed

  • A Relocation Package: Includes visa support for those who need it

  • Berlin Office Perks: Ergonomic setup, free daily lunch, and a dog-friendly environment.

  • Engaging and Diverse Work Environment: Join a diverse team, with over 30 nationalities working from over 25 different locations

* Benefits may vary depending on location and contract type. Do not hesitate to ask us about more details on our benefits offer.

Everyone's welcome here
At JustPlay, we believe different perspectives help us build better products. With team members from 30+ nationalities, different experiences and backgrounds are an important part of how we work and grow.
We hire based on skills, potential, and how you work. Your age, gender, ethnicity, religion, disability, sexual orientation, or background don't come into it. If you don't meet every requirement in this ad, apply anyway. We know great candidates don’t always tick every box and some of our best hires didn't either. We are looking forward to your application!

About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

You will work closely with core teams on the highest impact initiatives across engineering, product, hiring, operations, and business development. As the company grows, you'll help solve new challenges, build new capabilities, and drive execution wherever it matters most.

We're looking for people who learn quickly, think deeply, and enjoy solving difficult problems in a fast-moving environment.

What You'll Own

  • Drive high-priority initiatives across the business.

  • Work with leadership to solve business and product challenges.

  • Build new teams, processes, and capabilities as the company grows.

  • Lead cross-functional projects from planning through execution.

  • Research new markets, products, and business opportunities.

  • Improve how we operate by identifying problems and implementing practical solutions.

  • Take ownership of projects and deliver meaningful business outcomes.

What We're Looking For 

  • Strong problem-solving skills and business judgment.

  • Ability to learn quickly and adapt to new challenges.

  • Comfortable working across different business functions.

  • Strong ownership and execution skills.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

  • Able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-moving environment.

  • Curious, resourceful, and driven to build.

This Role Is Not For

  • People who only want to attend meetings. 

  • Candidates who cannot follow up aggressively and professionally. 

  • Those who need fixed scope and slow timelines. 

  • People who avoid messy cross-functional problems. 

  • People who produce long updates without clear decisions or next actions

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Singapore. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Singapore.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process:

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Role-specific interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process.

Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

About Backpack Healthcare

Backpack Healthcare is a venture-backed, Medicaid-first behavioral health company bringing pediatric and whole-family care to the communities that need it most. We partner with schools, health plans, and health systems across Maryland, Virginia, Georgia, Michigan, Illinois, and Kansas.

With 219 employees, more than 170 clinicians, and over 100 payer relationships, Backpack Healthcare is growing rapidly and expanding access to meaningful behavioral healthcare.

About the Opportunity

We are seeking a highly organized, proactive, and resourceful Founder's Associate to work directly alongside our Founder and CEO. This is an exciting opportunity for an ambitious early-career professional who wants firsthand exposure to how a high-growth healthcare company operates, scales, and makes strategic decisions.

In this role, you will serve as a trusted partner to the CEO, helping manage day-to-day priorities, executive communications, scheduling, travel, and special projects. You will also have opportunities to contribute to research, data analysis, board and investor materials, and cross-functional initiatives as you grow in the position.

This is a hands-on role that requires exceptional attention to detail, sound judgment, discretion, and the ability to adapt quickly in a fast-paced environment. No two days will look the same. You should be comfortable anticipating needs, solving problems independently, and keeping multiple priorities moving without losing sight of the details.

This position begins as a three-month temp-to-perm engagement, with the opportunity to transition into a permanent, full-time role based on performance and overall fit.

What You'll Do

Executive Support & Administration

  • Manage the CEO's calendar, inbox, meeting schedules, and daily priorities.

  • Coordinate meetings, resolve scheduling conflicts, and prepare agendas and materials in advance.

  • Draft executive communications, internal announcements, and responses for the CEO's review.

  • Maintain organized Google Drive folders, executive documents, board materials, and communication channels.

  • Manage executive expenses, receipts, vendor invoices, and expense submissions to ensure timely reconciliation.

  • Prepare daily summaries outlining upcoming meetings, outstanding priorities, and items requiring attention.

Executive & Group Travel Management

  • Coordinate end-to-end travel arrangements, including flights, hotels, ground transportation, restaurant reservations, and event registrations.

  • Organize group travel for company offsites, leadership retreats, conferences, and team events.

  • Negotiate hotel blocks, group rates, and venue packages.

  • Monitor travel disruptions and proactively coordinate alternative arrangements when needed.

  • Maintain travel itineraries, booking preferences, and a company-wide tracker of travel and event expenses.

  • Partner with Finance to review contracts, manage travel budgets, reconcile expenses, and ensure timely submission of receipts.

Meetings & Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Attend key meetings, capture notes, and document decisions, owners, and deadlines.

  • Track action items and follow up with team members to ensure timely completion.

  • Coordinate with department leaders across Finance, Operations, Clinical, Technology, HR, and Growth.

  • Maintain project trackers and provide follow-through on CEO-led initiatives.

  • Ensure open questions and outstanding requests are communicated and resolved.

Research, Data & Strategic Projects

  • Develop familiarity with company KPIs, dashboards, and reporting systems to quickly retrieve business information.

  • Assist with preparing presentations, board materials, and investor updates.

  • Conduct research on companies, industry topics, and individuals ahead of executive meetings.

  • Support special projects and operational initiatives as assigned.

  • Develop simple SOPs, templates, and processes to improve efficiency and organization.

Events & Special Projects

  • Support the planning and coordination of leadership retreats, company offsites, board dinners, and business events.

  • Coordinate venues, reservations, registrations, and event logistics.

  • Take ownership of special projects with increasing responsibility as you grow within the role.

What We're Looking For

Required Qualifications

  • 1–3 years of experience in an administrative, operations, coordinator, or associate role, preferably within a startup or fast-paced organization.

  • Demonstrated experience managing executive calendars, travel arrangements, and administrative responsibilities.

  • Strong organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to draft professional communications for executive audiences.

  • Experience coordinating travel logistics, including flights, hotels, ground transportation, and group arrangements.

  • Experience negotiating hotel blocks, group rates, or venue packages.

  • Working proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets, including formulas, pivot tables, and budget tracking.

  • Familiarity with Google Workspace, presentation tools, spreadsheets, and project management platforms.

  • Experience managing expenses, receipts, and travel budgets.

  • Comfortable using AI tools such as Claude to support research, drafting, summarization, and organization.

  • Ability to handle confidential information with professionalism and discretion.

  • Ability to receive feedback, adapt quickly, and take ownership of responsibilities.

The Qualities That Will Help You Succeed

  • Highly proactive, resourceful, and solutions-oriented.

  • Able to anticipate needs and address potential challenges before they become problems.

  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where priorities can change throughout the day.

  • Calm under pressure and capable of making sound decisions in real time.

  • Strong follow-through and accountability, with a commitment to closing the loop on every task.

  • Comfortable communicating with senior leaders, external partners, vendors, and investors.

  • Curious about business operations, healthcare, and the inner workings of a growing company.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Interest or experience in healthcare, behavioral health, or venture-backed startups.

  • Experience supporting a founder, CEO, or executive leadership team.

  • Experience with travel booking platforms, expense management systems, or event coordination.

  • Familiarity with dashboards, reporting, and basic data analysis.

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.

  • Healthcare or HIPAA-regulated environment experience.

  • Professional certifications in administration, corporate travel, or meeting and event planning.

  • Notary Public commission.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this position means becoming a dependable and trusted partner to the CEO while helping improve the efficiency of executive operations.

Within your first 90 days, you will:

  • Establish reliable systems for managing the CEO's calendar, inbox, travel, and daily priorities.

  • Ensure executive communications are triaged and addressed within one business day.

  • Maintain accurate expense documentation and ensure receipts are submitted before month-end close.

  • Become familiar with company KPIs and contribute to research and executive presentations.

  • Take ownership of at least one project from start to finish.

  • Successfully coordinate travel and collaborate with Finance on budget tracking and reconciliation.

Position Details

  • Employment Type: Full-time opportunity beginning with a three-month temp-to-perm engagement.

  • Location: Remote (U.S.-based).

  • Schedule: Must be available during Eastern Time business hours.

  • Travel: Occasional travel for company offsites and events.

  • Reports To: Founder and CEO.

  • Compensation: $72,500 starting annual rate, plus benefits.

  • Permanent Conversion: Based on performance and overall fit following the initial three-month engagement.

Why Join Backpack Healthcare?

This is an opportunity to work directly with a founder and gain meaningful exposure to executive leadership, business strategy, financial operations, and organizational growth.

You will have the opportunity to make an immediate impact, take ownership of important initiatives, and develop your skills alongside a growing team committed to expanding access to behavioral healthcare.

If you are someone who thrives on organization, enjoys solving problems, and wants to be part of building something meaningful, we would love to hear from you.

How to Apply

Interested candidates should submit a resume along with a few sentences explaining why they are interested in working directly alongside a founder.

Finalists will participate in a short practical exercise that may include organizing a sample executive calendar and travel itinerary, reviewing and summarizing emails, planning a group trip within a designated budget, or drafting an executive response.
